findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (Senate roll call 693, passed 28-13)
findings.note: The Senate member vote list shows Aye for Sawrey on second reading of HB 958. The ratified bill (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) says a voter registration application is processed only if it affirmatively states the applicant is a US citizen; an applicant who leaves the question blank gets a notice and 30 days to return a statement under penalty of perjury. It also directs the State Board of Elections to set up a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. The Governor vetoed it on 2026-08-17 per the bill page https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958.
